questions.text:
The country of Zombieland is in distress since more than 75% of its working population is suffering from serious health issues. Studies conducted by competent health experts concluded that a complete lack of physical exercise among its working population was one of the leading causes of their health issues. As one of the measures to address the problem, the Government of Zombieland has decided to provide monetary incentives to those who ride bicycles to work.
Based only on the information provided above, which one of the following statements can be logically inferred with certainty?
questions.solution:
The government gives incentives for cycling because lack of exercise is a cause of the health issues. This only makes sense if it believes cycling is a form of physical exercise.

The other options claim things the passage does not support (everyone will cycle, all will be healthy, experts asked for it to be mandatory).

Answer: The Government of Zombieland believes that riding bicycles is a form of physical exercise

questions.text:
Consider two functions of time [latex](t)[/latex],
[latex]f(t)=0.01t^2[/latex]
[latex]g(t)=4t[/latex]
where
[latex]0 \lt t \lt \infty[/latex]
Now consider the following two statements:

(i) For some [latex] t \gt 0, g(t) \gt f(t)[/latex].
(ii) There exists a [latex]T[/latex], such that [latex]f(t) \gt g(t)[/latex] for all [latex]t \gt T[/latex] .

Which one of the following options is TRUE?
questions.solution:
[latex]g(t) \gt f(t)\iff4t \gt 0.01t^2\iff t \lt 400[/latex] (for t [latex]\gt[/latex] 0).

- (i) For any t between 0 and 400, g(t) [latex]\gt[/latex] f(t) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] correct.
- (ii) Take T = 400: for all t [latex]\gt[/latex] 400, f(t) [latex]\gt[/latex] g(t) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] correct.

Answer: both (i) and (ii) are correct

questions.text:
Which one of the following sentence sequences creates a coherent narrative?

(i) Once on the terrace, on her way to her small room in the corner, she notices the man right away.
(ii) She begins to pant by the time she has climbed all the stairs.
(iii) Mina has bought vegetables and rice at the market, so her bags are heavy.
(iv) He was leaning against the parapet, watching the traffic below.
questions.solution:
Follow the story:
- (iii) introduces Mina and her heavy bags.
- (ii) explains that she pants after climbing the stairs (because of the bags).
- (i) she reaches the terrace and notices "the man".
- (iv) describes him ("He was leaning[latex]\ldots[/latex]").

Answer: (iii), (ii), (i), (iv)

questions.text:
[latex]f(x)[/latex] and [latex]g(y)[/latex] are functions of [latex]x[/latex] and [latex]y[/latex], respectively, and
 [latex]f(x)=g(y)[/latex] for all real
values of [latex]x[/latex] and [latex]y[/latex]. Which one of the following options is necessarily TRUE for all
 [latex]x[/latex] and [latex]y[/latex]?
questions.solution:
Fix y = [latex]y_0[/latex]: then [latex]f(x)=g(y_0)[/latex] for every x, so f is constant. In the same way g is constant, and the two constants are equal.

They need not be 0, and option 4 would force [latex]g(y)=0[/latex].

Answer: f(x) = g(y) = constant

questions.text: Which one of the options best describes the transformation of the 2-dimensional figure P to Q, and then to R, as shown?
questions.solution:
Track the long spike of the star:
- P [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] Q: the spike turns from pointing right to pointing down [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] a 90[latex]^\circ[/latex] clockwise rotation.
- Q [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] R: the spike flips from pointing down to pointing up, with left and right unchanged [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] reflection along a horizontal line.

Answer: Clockwise rotation by 90[latex]^\circ[/latex], then reflection along a horizontal line
